arabicExcerpts.text: ۞وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَخۡرَجۡنَا لَهُمۡ دَآبَّةٗ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمۡ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ
وَيَوۡمَ نَحۡشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ فَوۡجٗا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُمۡ يُوزَعُونَ
حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبۡتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِي وَلَمۡ تُحِيطُواْ بِهَا عِلۡمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
وَوَقَعَ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ عَلَيۡهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُواْ فَهُمۡ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
أَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّا جَعَلۡنَا ٱلَّيۡلَ لِيَسۡكُنُواْ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبۡصِرًاۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
وَيَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوۡهُ دَٰخِرِينَ
وَتَرَى ٱلۡجِبَالَ تَحۡسَبُهَا جَامِدَةٗ وَهِيَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِۚ صُنۡعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَتۡقَنَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٖ يَوۡمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ
وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتۡ وُجُوهُهُمۡ فِي ٱلنَّارِ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
إِنَّمَآ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡبَلۡدَةِ ٱلَّذِي حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَيۡءٖۖ وَأُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُسۡلِمِينَ
وَأَنۡ أَتۡلُوَاْ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَۖ فَمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهۡتَدِي لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنذِرِينَ
وَقُلِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَتَعۡرِفُونَهَاۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Beast-sign (dabbat al-ard) speaking to people as eschatological marker; Judgment Day gathering of jinn and humans; denial confronted with prior sign-encompassment; decree execution silencing wrongdoers; night-day cycle as belief-enabling signs; Horn-blowing causing universal terror with divine exception; mountain dissolution as cosmic transformation demonstrating divine perfection; individual reward-punishment based on deed quality; sacred city (Mecca) as worship locus; Quran recitation as prophetic function; guidance-straying as individual outcome; closing hamd with promise of future sign-recognition

subordinateSubjects.label: Earth-emerging beast appearing when the divine decree falls, addressing humanity's lack of certainty in the signs
Judgment Day muster drawing a contingent from every nation composed specifically of those who denied the signs, organized in ranks
Divine interrogation confronting deniers about rejecting signs they never fully comprehended and questioning their worldly conduct
Decree falling upon wrongdoers rendering them speechless in the face of justified punishment
Night ordained for rest and day for visibility presented as signs requiring active belief
Horn blast terrifying all celestial and terrestrial beings except those divinely exempted, all arriving in humility
Mountains perceived as solid actually drifting like clouds demonstrating Allah's perfect craftsmanship and complete awareness of human actions
Bearer of good deeds receiving something better and enjoying security from the terror of that Day
Bearer of evil deeds cast face-down into the Fire repaid exactly according to prior actions
Prophetic mandate restricted to worshipping the Lord of the sacred city who owns everything and to being among those who submit
Additional mandate to recite the Quran coupled with the principle that guidance benefits the guided while the Prophet serves only as warner to the astray
Closing instruction to praise Allah with the promise that He will reveal signs recognizable to humanity while remaining fully aware of all deeds
